briefing.text: Does a modal opened again with new values show them? Press 1 to 14: the modal shows SANTISSIMA ANNUNZIATA 24.7, show number 1. Press the first button (or Change hospital here for 5), then Pick PIERANGELI. The modal opens again: it must show PIERANGELI 35.9. Read also the show number in the text. Press the button that says what you see. No server and no map needed.
